title: Design and synthesis of dual inhibitors targeting snail and histone deacetylase for the treatment of solid tumour cancer.
authors: Cui, Hao; Huang, Jingkun; Lei, Yan; Chen, Quanwei; Hu, Zan; Niu, Jiaqi; Wei, Ran; Yang, Kang; Li, Hongmei; Lu, Tao; Zhu, Yong; Huang, Yatian
one_liner_zh: 该文设计合成Snail/HDAC双靶点抑制剂并做抗肿瘤活性测试，虽含分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Snail and histone deacetylases (HDACs) have an important impact on cancer treatment, especially for their synergy. Therefore, the development of inhibitors targeting both Snail and HDAC might be a promising strategy for the treatment of cancers. In this work, we synthesized a series of Snail/HDAC dual inhibitors. Compound 9n displayed the most potent inhibitory activity against HDAC1 with an IC(50) of 0.405 muM, potent inhibition against Snail with a K(d) of 0.180 muM, and antiproliferative activity in HCT-116 cell lines with an IC(50) of 0.0751 muM. Compound 9n showed a good inhibitory effect on NCI-H522 (GI(50) = 0.0488 muM), MDA-MB-435 (GI(50) = 0.0361 muM), and MCF7 (GI(50) = 0.0518 muM). Docking studies showed that compound 9n can be well docked into the active binding sites of Snail and HDAC. Further studies showed that compound 9n increased histone H4 acetylation in HCT-116 cells and decreased the expression of Snail protein to induce cell apoptosis. These findings highlight the potential for the development of Snail/HDAC dual inhibitors as anti-solid tumour cancer drugs.
abstract_zh: Snail和组蛋白去乙酰化酶（HDACs）在癌症治疗中具有重要影响，尤其是它们的协同作用。因此，开发同时靶向Snail和HDAC的抑制剂可能成为治疗癌症的一种有前景的策略。在本研究中，我们合成了一系列Snail/HDAC双靶点抑制剂。化合物9n对HDAC1表现出最强的抑制活性，IC(50)为0.405 μM，对Snail具有强效抑制作用，K(d)为0.180 μM，并在HCT-116细胞系中显示出抗增殖活性，IC(50)为0.0751 μM。化合物9n对NCI-H522（GI(50) = 0.0488 μM）、MDA-MB-435（GI(50) = 0.0361 μM）和MCF7（GI(50) = 0.0518 μM）表现出良好的抑制效果。对接研究表明，化合物9n能良好地对接至Snail和HDAC的活性结合位点。进一步研究表明，化合物9n在HCT-116细胞中增加了组蛋白H4的乙酰化水平，并降低了Snail蛋白的表达，从而诱导细胞凋亡。这些发现凸显了开发Snail/HDAC双靶点抑制剂作为抗实体瘤癌症药物的潜力。
